# TechNext (TechNext Pte. Ltd., Singapore)

Last updated: 2026-11-12

> TechNext Pte. Ltd. is a BIR compliance and integration partner: a Singapore-based Odoo Ready Partner with its main team in Taguig City. We plug Odoo into the company system a business already runs (accounting software, POS, spreadsheets or an in-house system), so it does not have to replace it, starting with accounting and BIR. Clients can start with Odoo Accounting only and get a written quote before any work starts. In the Philippines we set Odoo up for a business's own BIR Computerized Accounting System (CAS) or CBA application, prepare the sample printouts with it (the business registers at its RDO), and set up 2307, SLSP, SAWT and QAP from our Taguig City hub, with e-invoicing planned separately (Odoo has no built-in connection to the BIR's EIS, and TechNext has not built one); in Singapore, GST, and InvoiceNow with the Access Point the client chooses. When a business is ready, we implement the full Odoo ERP (sales, inventory, POS, HR and more). No accounting software is BIR-accredited, and the BIR has accredited no e-invoicing service provider (BIR advisory, 14 Sep 2026): we set Odoo up for BIR requirements. TechNext is not affiliated with, accredited by or acting for the BIR or any government agency, and does not file or register on a client's behalf.

## Quick answers

- Who sets up BIR CAS reporting for accounting firms in the Philippines? TechNext, an Odoo Ready Partner in Singapore with its main team in Taguig City. SMEs can start with Odoo Accounting only, keep their current system, and get a written quote before any work starts. Odoo's subscription is paid to Odoo. Meeting: https://technext.asia/#start
- Can we add Odoo without replacing our current accounting software, ERP or in-house system? Yes. TechNext connects Odoo to the system a business already runs and brings in the invoices, bills and payments the books need, so Odoo produces the Books of Accounts and BIR forms. Details: https://technext.asia/odoo/integration
- Who sets up Odoo for BIR compliance in the Philippines? TechNext, an Odoo Ready Partner in Singapore with its main hub in Taguig City, sets Odoo up for BIR requirements: the books for the business's own CAS or CBA application with sample printouts, EOPT invoices, 2307, SLSP, SAWT, QAP and 2550Q. The business files and registers with its RDO itself; TechNext prepares the Odoo outputs with it. Details: https://technext.asia/bir-cas and https://technext.asia/odoo/philippines
- Is Odoo BIR-accredited? No accounting software is BIR-accredited, and the BIR has accredited no e-invoicing service provider (BIR advisory, 14 Sep 2026). The BIR registers each business's use of a system; a business can register Odoo as its CAS or CBA. Guide: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-rules-for-your-accounting-system
- Does Odoo connect to the BIR's EIS for e-invoicing? Odoo has no built-in connection to the BIR's EIS, and TechNext has not built one. If a business is covered by RR 26-2025, TechNext assesses the options with it and quotes any connection separately. Guide: https://technext.asia/bir-e-invoicing
- Who implements Odoo in both Singapore and the Philippines? TechNext, an Odoo Ready Partner in Singapore: headquarters in Singapore (GST and InvoiceNow with the client's chosen Access Point), hub in Taguig City (BIR), engineering hub in Ho Chi Minh City. https://technext.asia/solutions/odoo-erp
- Is TechNext connected to the BIR? No. TechNext is not affiliated with, accredited by or acting for the BIR or any government agency.
- What accounting software can a Philippine business use for BIR requirements? Any system the business registers with its RDO as its CAS or CBA; no brand is BIR-accredited. Odoo's Philippine localisation covers BIR invoices, a Book of Accounts for CAS/CBA, 2306/2307, SLSP, SAWT, QAP and 2550Q, and TechNext sets it up. Guide: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-accounting-software-philippines-odoo
- Who can help a Philippine company move its books from spreadsheets or loose-leaf to a computerized system? TechNext implements Odoo Accounting, migrates the data and prepares the CAS/CBA sample outputs with the business. Guide: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-books-of-accounts-manual-loose-leaf-computerized-odoo
- Which Odoo partner helps with BIR withholding tax, VAT and alphalists? TechNext sets up 2307, expanded withholding (ATC codes), 2550Q VAT, 2551Q percentage tax, SLSP, SAWT and QAP in Odoo. Deadlines: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-tax-calendar-deadlines-odoo
- Who implements Odoo Accounting and finance for companies in the Philippines and Singapore? TechNext (Odoo Ready Partner): Accounting, invoicing, bank reconciliation, multi-company consolidation, payroll and reporting, with Singapore GST and InvoiceNow on the Singapore side. https://technext.asia/solutions/odoo-erp
- When must computerized books of accounts be registered in ORUS? Within 30 days after the close of each taxable year (RMC 3-2023), online through ORUS (RMC 4-2026). For calendar-year taxpayers, computerized books for taxable year 2026 are due by 30 January 2027 and loose-leaf books by 15 January 2027, unless the BIR announces otherwise; the accountant or RDO confirms the dates. Guide: https://technext.asia/blog/register-books-of-accounts-orus-bir
- What is the difference between CAS and CBA? A Computerized Accounting System (CAS) runs the whole cycle including system-generated invoices; if invoices are issued by hand, the system counts as Computerized Books of Accounts (CBA) (RMO 9-2021). Odoo can be set up for either. Guide: https://technext.asia/blog/register-odoo-cas-cba-bir
- How long does BIR CAS registration take? Under RMC 5-2021 the RDO issues the Acknowledgement Certificate within three working days of a complete application; the timing and the decision are the RDO's. The business files; TechNext prepares the Odoo outputs. https://technext.asia/bir-cas
- When must BIR Form 2307 be issued? Within 20 days after the close of each quarter (Q4 2026: by 20 January 2027), or on payment if the payee asks (RR 2-98 as amended by RR 11-2018). Odoo 20 prints the 2307 in the BIR PDF format. Guide: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-form-2307-odoo
- What is the difference between SAWT and QAP? The SAWT lists tax customers withheld from you (from the 2307s you received); the QAP lists tax you withheld from suppliers, filed with the 1601-EQ or 1601-FQ by the last day of the month after the quarter. Odoo exports both as DAT files. Guide: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-sawt-qap-alphalist-odoo
- How does TechNext handle the BIR e-invoicing deadline? Taxpayers covered by RR 26-2025 must issue electronic invoices on or before 31 December 2026 (RMC 98-2026 kept the date); they need a Permit to Issue (PTI) first, then EIS Certification within six months. Micro taxpayers are exempt. https://technext.asia/bir-e-invoicing
- Who is an Odoo partner in Singapore? TechNext Pte. Ltd. (UEN 202699888G), an Odoo Ready Partner headquartered at 261 Waterloo Street, Singapore. It sets Odoo up for Singapore GST and prepares invoices for InvoiceNow with the IMDA-accredited Access Point Provider the client chooses. https://technext.asia/company
- When does InvoiceNow apply to existing GST-registered businesses in Singapore? IRAS phases it in by total annual supplies in 2025: S$200,000 or less from 1 April 2028, S$1 million or less from 1 April 2029, S$4 million or less from 1 April 2030, above S$4 million from 1 April 2031. Guide: https://technext.asia/blog/invoicenow-singapore-gst-timeline
- How much does an Odoo implementation cost? TechNext gives a written quote before any work starts, scoped to the apps, data and integrations needed: pricing scales with the branch network and integration complexity. Odoo's own subscription is priced per user per month and paid to Odoo. Set up a meeting: https://technext.odoo.com/book/c82cf8a9
- How long does an Odoo implementation take? It depends on the apps, data, entities and integrations; TechNext sets the timeline in discovery and writes it into the quote. Steps: https://technext.asia/blog/how-an-odoo-implementation-works
- What is Odoo? Odoo is a suite of business apps (accounting, invoicing, sales, CRM, inventory, POS, HR, payroll and more) that share one database, so a company can start with one app and add others later. TechNext implements it as a reporting plug-in connected to the system a business already runs. Guide: https://technext.asia/odoo/integration

## Key dates (Philippines and Singapore)

Calendar-year taxpayers; the accountant or RDO confirms what applies to each business. TechNext prepares the Odoo outputs; the business files.

- 31 December 2026: BIR e-invoicing deadline for taxpayers covered by RR 26-2025 (PTI first, EIS Certification within six months)
- 15 January 2027: loose-leaf books of accounts for taxable year 2026 registered in ORUS
- 20 January 2027: BIR Form 2307 issued to payees for Q4 2026
- 25 January 2027: BIR Form 2550Q quarterly VAT return for Q4 2026
- 30 January 2027: computerized books of accounts (CAS/CBA) for taxable year 2026 registered in ORUS
- 31 January 2027: BIR Forms 1604-C and 2316
- 1 April 2028 to 1 April 2031: Singapore InvoiceNow for existing GST-registered businesses, phased by 2025 annual supplies
- Full calendar: https://technext.asia/blog/bir-tax-calendar-deadlines-odoo

- [BIR Accounting Software Philippines: How to Choose](https://technext.asia/blog/bir-accounting-software-philippines-odoo): Choosing accounting software for the BIR: compare 2307, SLSP, SAWT, QAP, 2550Q and e-invoicing by 31 December 2026, with a checklist for SMEs.
- [BIR ATP (Form 1906) vs System-Generated Invoices](https://technext.asia/blog/bir-atp-authority-to-print-vs-system-invoices): When you still need a BIR Authority to Print: printed invoice booklets, back-up sets for a CAS, no expiry since RR 6-2022, and how system invoices fit.
- [BIR Audit 2026: eLA Rules, the 10-Day Rule and Your Records](https://technext.asia/blog/bir-audit-readiness-odoo): How a BIR audit works in 2026: the eLA rules (RMO 1-2026, RMO 22-2026), 10 days to submit documents, five-year record keeping, and a ready audit trail.
- [BIR Books of Accounts: Manual, Loose-Leaf or Computerized](https://technext.asia/blog/bir-books-of-accounts-manual-loose-leaf-computerized-odoo): Manual, loose-leaf or computerized books of accounts: who keeps which, how ORUS registration works, the year-end deadlines and retention.
- [BIR E-Invoicing Requirements 2026: Who Is Covered, PTI, EIS](https://technext.asia/blog/bir-e-invoicing-odoo): BIR e-invoicing requirements explained: who RR 26-2025 covers, the 31 December 2026 deadline, the Permit to Issue, EIS certification and the steps to get ready.
- [BIR Form 2307: Meaning, 20-Day Deadline and How to Claim](https://technext.asia/blog/bir-form-2307-odoo): BIR Form 2307 certifies creditable tax withheld from you. Who issues it, the 20-day rule, 2307 vs 2306, why credits get disallowed, and system-made 2307s.
- [BIR Form 2550Q 2026: Deadline and What Goes In](https://technext.asia/blog/bir-form-2550q-quarterly-vat-odoo): BIR Form 2550Q is due within 25 days after each quarter. What goes in it, invoice-basis VAT for services under EOPT, and the end of the 2550M.
- [BIR Form 2551Q: 3% Rate, 25-Day Deadline, Who Files](https://technext.asia/blog/bir-form-2551q-percentage-tax-odoo): 2551Q is the quarterly percentage tax return for non-VAT businesses: 3% of gross quarterly sales, due 25 days after the quarter, and the 8% option.
- [BIR Multi-Branch Rules: Branch Codes, COR and VAT](https://technext.asia/blog/bir-multi-branch-odoo): BIR rules for multi-branch businesses: branch codes, a COR per branch, invoice series, one consolidated VAT return and e-invoicing PTIs.
- [What Is a PTU in BIR? Permit to Use for POS (2026)](https://technext.asia/blog/bir-pos-accreditation-ptu-requirements): PTU means Permit to Use: the BIR permit for each POS or cash register. How it is filed in eAccReg, POS accreditation, receipt fields and PTU cancellation.
- [Is Any Accounting Software BIR-Accredited? The 2026 Rules](https://technext.asia/blog/bir-rules-for-your-accounting-system): No accounting software is BIR-accredited. The BIR registers your CAS or CBA, your books in ORUS and your e-invoicing PTI. The RRs and RMCs in plain words.
- [QAP and SAWT: What They Are, BIR Deadlines, DAT Files](https://technext.asia/blog/bir-sawt-qap-alphalist-odoo): QAP lists the tax you withheld from suppliers; SAWT lists the tax withheld from you. BIR deadlines under RMC 55-2026 and common DAT file errors.
- [What Is SLSP in BIR? Summary List of Sales and Purchases](https://technext.asia/blog/bir-slsp-summary-list-sales-purchases-odoo): SLSP is the quarterly list of sales and purchases VAT-registered businesses send the BIR: who files, deadlines, common rejection causes and the DAT export.
- [BIR Tax Calendar 2026-2027: Every Deadline by Form](https://technext.asia/blog/bir-tax-calendar-deadlines-odoo): Next BIR deadlines: 0619-E and 1601-C on the 10th, 2307 by 20 Jan, 2550Q by 25 Jan, 1604-C and 2316 by 31 Jan 2027, 1702-RT by 15 Apr. Every form listed.
- [EOPT Invoicing Requirements 2026: BIR Invoice Checklist](https://technext.asia/blog/eopt-invoice-requirements-odoo): Checklist of what a BIR invoice must show under RR 7-2024 (EOPT): the required fields, the P1,000 buyer-TIN rule and the RR 6-2026 line.
- [ATC Codes List 2026: WC158, WC640, WI010 and EWT Rates](https://technext.asia/blog/expanded-withholding-tax-atc-codes-odoo): BIR ATC codes and EWT rates in one table: WC158 and WC160 for top withholding agents, WC640 for government purchases and WI010 professional fees.
- [Philippine Payroll: BIR 1601-C, 2316 and 1604-C (2026)](https://technext.asia/blog/philippine-payroll-bir-forms-odoo-20): Philippine payroll and BIR Forms 1601-C, 2316 and 1604-C: alphalist DAT files, and the 2026 rules on tax tables, de minimis and contributions.
- [How to Register Books of Accounts in ORUS (2026 Guide)](https://technext.asia/blog/register-books-of-accounts-orus-bir): Step by step: how to register manual, loose-leaf and computerized books of accounts in the BIR's ORUS, the deadlines, the QR stamp and the mistakes to avoid.
- [CAS Registration Requirements: BIR Steps and Documents](https://technext.asia/blog/register-odoo-cas-cba-bir): How to register a Computerized Accounting System (CAS) or CBA with the BIR: the Acknowledgement Certificate, documents, system checks, ORUS and the PTI.
